payload.core_mechanism_summary: Generate all reachable values by repeated halving for each array element, then for each value, greedily select k smallest operation counts.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively collects all possible target numbers and the cost to reach each, then for each target with at least k entries, picks the k smallest costs via counting sort. This is a brute-force complete search over the finite state space; no sliding window or amortized analysis is used.
